content: Our model uses two encoders: $e_{\mathit {seq}}$ for encoding the sequential history ($x_{<i}$), and $e_{\mathit {syn}}$ for shallow syntactic (chunk) history ($c_{\leqslant i}$). For both, we use transformers BIBREF16, which consist of large feedforward networks equipped with multiheaded self-attention mechanisms.
